headline: Quieter rounds, and no more output-limit errors
pill: no more popups while the agents work
summary: Conversations you start from the chat no longer pop up a notification for every turn, and Claude no longer stops with an "output exceeded the configured limit" error when it reads large files.
improvements: No progress popup, and no notification sound, while a round started from the chat runs. Stop it from the composer as before.
Cancelled and failed rounds are shown in the chat only, without an extra popup.
Rounds started from the Command Palette keep the progress popup and its Cancel button.
fixes: Claude stopped with **output exceeded the configured limit of 1048576 bytes** when it read large files or searched a big codebase: everything it read counted against the limit. The limit now applies to the reply only; a separate 64 MB cap still stops a runaway process.
